- scripts/claude_engine.py:1314-1326 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `_snapshot_metadata` does not check for shared or detached sibling worktrees before copying the shared Git object store into the read-profile container.
  WHY: Objects from a detached sibling worktree can remain accessible in the copied store and expose secret-bearing content through Git tools.
- scripts/claude_engine.py:1319-1326 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `_snapshot_metadata` does not check for unreachable Git objects before copying the shared object store.
  WHY: Credential-bearing objects left by SHA-only fetches can evade the ref-based history scan and remain retrievable inside the container.
- scripts/claude_engine.py:1319 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `_snapshot_metadata` buffers the complete `git log --all` history-path output with `subprocess.check_output`.
  WHY: Large histories can exhaust runner memory before snapshotting completes.
- .github/workflows/claude-engine-smoke.yml:113 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The smoke-test regex rejects the valid `filtered_history` isolation reason.
  WHY: `grep -Eq` fails under `set -euo pipefail` when a valid isolation run reports `filtered_history`, causing the smoke step to fail. Severity disagreement: MAJOR and BLOCKER were reported; using the highest.
- scripts/ai_engine.sh:465 | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `CLAUDE_ISOLATION` log line still includes the `extra_dirs=` suffix despite the stated intent to preserve the historical suffix-free format.
  WHY: Consumers that match the historical exact-suffix form may fail to recognize the line.
- tests/test_ai_engine.py:436 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The test checks for the `CLAUDE_ISOLATION` text anywhere in stderr rather than asserting that it appears as a complete line.
  WHY: The test can pass even if the log line is concatenated with additional text, leaving the stated regression undetected.

  PROBLEM: `_snapshot_metadata` buffers the complete history-path output from `_snapshot_git(workdir, "log", "--all", ...)` in a single `check_output` call.
  WHY: On repositories with large histories and many tracked files, the output can exhaust runner memory before the snapshot completes.

  PROBLEM: `_snapshot_metadata` has no shared-worktree guard before copying the shared object store.
  WHY: A detached sibling worktree can contain credential-bearing commits whose blobs are accessible in the container.
- scripts/claude_engine.py:1311-1370 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: `_snapshot_metadata` has no unreachable-object check before copying the full object store.
  WHY: Credential-bearing objects from SHA-only fetches can evade the ref-based history scan and be retrieved inside the container.

  PROBLEM: The smoke-test regex does not match `filtered_history`.
  WHY: A valid read-profile run with that isolation reason causes `grep -Eq` to exit non-zero under `set -euo pipefail`.

- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The linked issue (#6282) requires read-profile roles to run in filesystem-isolated containers with sanitized data only. The most recent autofix commit (b9fa567) claimed to add three object-store hardening measures: (a) shared/detached worktree isolation, (b) unreachable-object scanning via `git fsck`, and (c) streamed history processing via Popen instead of one-shot `check_output`.
  Expected change site: `scripts/claude_engine.py` function `_snapshot_metadata` (lines 1311-1370)
  Evidence of absence: Line 1319 uses `_snapshot_git(workdir, "log", "--all", ...)` as a one-shot `check_output` call, not a `subprocess.Popen`-based streaming read. No shared worktree check exists between line 1314 and line 1319. No `git fsck --unreachable --no-reflogs` probe exists. The tests `test_read_snapshot_omits_shared_detached_history` and `test_read_snapshot_omits_unreachable_fetched_commit` are absent from `tests/test_claude_engine.py`. These three protections and their tests exist in the LAST RUN DIFF but are absent from the current checkout.
  SEVERITY: critical
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

  Evidence of absence: The regex on disk is `(none|alternates)`, not `(none|alternates|filtered_history)`. A valid `filtered_history` isolation result causes the smoke step to fail. The `test_smoke_accepts_filtered_history_snapshot` contract test claimed by the LAST RUN DIFF is absent from `tests/test_claude_read_isolation_wiring_contract.py`.
  SEVERITY: critical

  PROBLEM: `_snapshot_metadata` does not check for shared or detached sibling worktrees or unreachable objects before copying the shared object store into the read-profile container.
  WHY: A detached-worktree commit or an unreferenced object from a SHA-only fetch can be retrieved inside the container, exposing content the working tree never exposed.
- scripts/claude_engine.py: line 1319 (`history_paths = _snapshot_git(workdir, "log", "--all", ...)`) | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The history scan buffers the entire `git log --all --name-only -z` output in a single bytes object via `subprocess.check_output`.
  WHY: A large history can exhaust runner memory before the filter loop runs.
- .github/workflows/claude-engine-smoke.yml: line 113 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The smoke regex does not accept the valid `filtered_history` isolation reason.
  WHY: `grep -Eq` exits non-zero under `set -euo pipefail`, failing the smoke step even when isolation is functioning correctly.
- scripts/ai_engine.sh: line 465 | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The `CLAUDE_ISOLATION` log line still emits the `extra_dirs=` suffix despite the stated backward-compatibility intent to remove it.
  WHY: External log scanning that expects the historical exact-suffix format may not match the line.
- tests/test_ai_engine.py: line 436 (`assert "CLAUDE_ISOLATION role=SECURITY_AUDIT profile=read mode=container" in result.stderr`) | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The test asserts that the log text appears somewhere in stderr but does not assert that it is a complete line.
  WHY: The test can pass without detecting a regression that concatenates the log text with other output.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: Linked issue #6282 states: "Run read-profile roles in a filesystem-isolated container containing only sanitized task data; keep token files, Git credentials, and runner files outside it, and broker model access without mounting credentials." The PR description's AD-2 specifies "a sanitized copy of the workdir in which .git is kept but credential-bearing config (for example http.*.extraheader) is stripped" plus the documented history handling. AD-3 specifies fail-closed fallbacks for container/relay/snapshot failures.
  Expected change site: `scripts/claude_engine.py::_snapshot_metadata` (lines 1311-1370) for the three object-store defenses; `.github/workflows/claude-engine-smoke.yml:113` for the smoke regex; `scripts/ai_engine.sh:465` for the legacy log-line cleanup; the corresponding regression tests in `tests/test_claude_engine.py` and `tests/test_claude_read_isolation_wiring_contract.py`.

There is no `(common / "worktrees").exists()` check, no `subprocess.Popen` streaming loop, and no `git fsck --unreachable` probe. `tests/test_claude_engine.py` is missing `test_read_snapshot_omits_shared_detached_history` and `test_read_snapshot_omits_unreachable_fetched_commit` (confirmed by `grep` — only the other 9 new tests exist). `tests/test_claude_read_isolation_wiring_contract.py` does not contain `test_smoke_accepts_filtered_history_snapshot` (the file ends at line 24 with only two tests). The smoke regex at `claude-engine-smoke.yml:113` still reads `reason=(none|alternates)` and rejects `filtered_history`. The `CLAUDE_ISOLATION` line at `scripts/ai_engine.sh:465` still includes `extra_dirs=$((${#extra_roots[@]} + ${#AI_ENGINE_ISOLATION_PATHS[@]}))`.
